overview_description.description:
Hey Healthcare provides healthcare software designed to automate medical billing. Its platform offers reporting, authorizations, denial management, A/R work, and credentialing while automating claim tracking and reporting, enabling healthcare providers to manage billing process.

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
